# Plan

Reproduce Fig. 2f of Liu et al. 2026: sequence logos of the 12 **MDCs** (METTL13-dependent
codons - codons enriched in mRNAs whose nascent protein falls on METTL13 knockout) against the
other 49 sense codons. The paper's claim: *"a strong preference for adenine or uracil (A/U) at
the third (wobble) position (11 out of 12 MDCs) in comparison to all coding codons (30 out of
61 codons; Fig. 2f)"*.

**Construction.** Each codon counts once, unweighted by usage. Letter height = frequency x
information content, IC = 2 - Shannon entropy (bits), with **no small-sample correction**. That
choice is not stated in the paper; it is the one that reproduces the published heights (MDC
position 3 ~0.7 bits; the corrected version would give ~0.5).

# Extract the MDC list from the paper

The 12 MDCs appear only as labels in Fig. 2 (the red points in panel a, listed under "MDCs" in
the figure text). Rather than retype them, the codons are parsed from the PDF's text layer using
macOS PDFKit, then checked against four independent statements in the paper. Figure-label text can be
scrambled in extraction, so the list has **not** been confirmed by eye against the red points in
Fig. 2a; the assertions below are what it rests on.

```{r extract}
pdf_path <- here("accessories", "liu2026_ncb_s41556-026-02085-6.pdf")
stopifnot(file.exists(pdf_path))

js <- sprintf(paste0('ObjC.import("PDFKit"); var d=$.PDFDocument.alloc.initWithURL(',
                     '$.NSURL.fileURLWithPath("%s")); var s=""; for (var i=0;i<d.pageCount;i++)',
                     '{ s+="\\n"+d.pageAtIndex(i).string.js } s'), pdf_path)
paper_txt <- paste(system2("osascript", c("-l", "JavaScript", "-e", shQuote(js)), stdout = TRUE),
                   collapse = "\n")
stopifnot("PDF text extraction returned nothing" = nchar(paper_txt) > 1e5,
          grepl("Identification of METTL13-dependent codons", paper_txt, fixed = TRUE))

hits <- str_match_all(paper_txt, "\\nMDCs\\s*\\n((?:[ACGU]{3} ){11}[ACGU]{3})\\s*\\n")[[1]]
cat("Lines matching 'MDCs' + 12 codons:", nrow(hits), "\n")
stopifnot("expected exactly one MDC label line in the figure text" = nrow(hits) == 1)

mdc <- str_split(hits[1, 2], " ")[[1]]
cat("MDCs:", mdc, "\n")
```

# Checks

```{r checks}
gc_rna <- setNames(GENETIC_CODE, chartr("T", "U", names(GENETIC_CODE)))
sense  <- names(gc_rna)[gc_rna != "*"]
stopifnot(length(sense) == 61)

other <- setdiff(sense, mdc)

stopifnot(
  "12 unique MDCs"                = length(mdc) == 12, !anyDuplicated(mdc),
  "all MDCs are sense codons"     = all(mdc %in% sense),
  "49 other codons"               = length(other) == 49,
  # Main text names these three as MDCs (smFRET UUU vs UUC; Fig. 2h legend: CCA and CCU)
  "UUU, CCA, CCU named in text"   = all(c("UUU", "CCA", "CCU") %in% mdc),
  # "11 out of 12 MDCs" end in A/U
  "11 of 12 MDCs end in A/U"      = sum(substr(mdc, 3, 3) %in% c("A", "U")) == 11,
  # "30 out of 61 codons" end in A/U
  "30 of 61 sense codons end A/U" = sum(substr(sense, 3, 3) %in% c("A", "U")) == 30
)

# Fig. 2h x axis lists the MDC amino acids: K N T R P* E A V S L F (* = two proline MDCs)
aa <- AMINO_ACID_CODE[as.character(gc_rna[mdc])]
aa1 <- as.character(gc_rna[mdc])
fig2h_aa <- c("K", "N", "T", "R", "P", "E", "A", "V", "S", "L", "F")
print(table(aa1))
stopifnot("MDC amino acids differ from the Fig. 2h axis" = setequal(unique(aa1), fig2h_aa),
          "Fig. 2h marks proline as having two MDCs" = sum(aa1 == "P") == 2,
          "every other amino acid has one MDC" = all(table(aa1)[setdiff(fig2h_aa, "P")] == 1))

tibble(codon = mdc, amino_acid = aa1, third = substr(mdc, 3, 3)) %>% knitr::kable()
```

# Logo heights

```{r heights}
logo_matrix <- function(codons) {
  m <- sapply(1:3, function(i)
    table(factor(substr(codons, i, i), levels = c("A", "C", "G", "U"))) / length(codons))
  ic <- 2 + colSums(ifelse(m > 0, m * log2(m), 0))   # 2 - entropy, bits
  heights <- sweep(m, 2, ic, `*`)
  colnames(heights) <- 1:3
  list(freq = m, ic = ic, heights = heights)
}

lm_mdc   <- logo_matrix(mdc)
lm_other <- logo_matrix(other)

ic_tab <- rbind(MDCs = lm_mdc$ic, `Other codons` = lm_other$ic)
colnames(ic_tab) <- paste("position", 1:3)
knitr::kable(ic_tab, digits = 3, caption = "Information content per position (bits)")
knitr::kable(lm_mdc$heights, digits = 3, caption = "MDC letter heights (bits)")

# Published panel: MDC position 3 stack ~0.7 bits, A above U; positions 1-2 small; other codons flat
stopifnot(
  "MDC position-3 IC outside the published ~0.7" = between(lm_mdc$ic[3], 0.65, 0.70),
  "A should be the tallest letter at MDC position 3" =
    names(which.max(lm_mdc$heights[, 3])) == "A",
  "C should be the tallest letter at MDC position 2" =
    names(which.max(lm_mdc$heights[, 2])) == "C",
  "MDC positions 1-2 should be small" = all(lm_mdc$ic[1:2] < 0.25),
  "other codons should be near flat" = all(lm_other$ic < 0.1)
)
```

# Figure

Letter colors avoid the paper's orange and sky blue, which are reserved for eIF3d and eIF3e in
this project.

```{r logo, fig.width = 6, fig.height = 2.6}
nt_cols <- make_col_scheme(chars = c("A", "C", "G", "U"),
                           cols  = c("#009E73", "#0072B2", "black", "#D55E00"))

p_logo <- ggseqlogo(list(MDCs = lm_mdc$heights, `Other codons` = lm_other$heights),
                    method = "custom", seq_type = "rna", col_scheme = nt_cols, ncol = 2) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 0.75), breaks = seq(0, 0.75, 0.25)) +
  labs(x = "Nucleotide position", y = "Bits",
       caption = sprintf("n = %d MDCs, %d other sense codons; each codon counted once",
                         length(mdc), length(other))) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(strip.background = element_blank(), strip.text = element_text(size = 12),
        legend.position = "none")

p_logo

if (isTRUE(params$save_plots))
  ggsave(here("plots", "liu2026_04_mdc_codon_logo.pdf"), p_logo, width = 6, height = 2.6)
```
